issue.title: Record the native Chromium compatibility release matrix
issue.build: Aggregate focused native workflow results into a finite compatibility matrix for a declared release candidate, filing defects separately.
accept: Exercise install/launch/uninstall of a web app, extension popups, autofill/passkeys and print/download dialogs on native builds.
Verify notification clicks, protocol links, casting where supported and return from PiP choose the correct window/Profile.
Record per-OS compatibility and Widevine limitations; never bundle proprietary CDMs or suppress security prompts.
issue.readiness: Proposed work after native/reference prerequisites and explicit decisions in this issue.
issue.disposition: Recommended core integration or verification, with improvements preferred over literal Arc replication.
issue.referencePlatforms: Reference platform support is limited to the cited source. Documentary macOS or Windows coverage does not prove native behavior; Linux is a downstream design and verification target.
issue.referenceNote: REA 6.7.0 bundle/resource observations recorded in artifacts.md; no application execution or native-performance measurement.
issue.openQuestions: Native integration, failure behavior and applicable platform results must be proven for this slice; unavailable checks stay open.
